resource.title: Prompt Engineering — Glossary
resource.heroSubtitle: An A–Z glossary of Prompt Engineering: 250+ definitions covering prompts, LLM vocabulary, patterns, agent terminology, evaluation metrics, APIs and interview vocabulary — with beginner-friendly and technical explanations.

html:
1. Using this Glossary

  • Each entry gives a beginner-friendly definition, a technical note, an example and related concepts.
  • Skim §2 acronyms first — most confusion in prompt engineering is acronym-driven.
  • §10 is a one-line quick index for revision.

4. LLM Vocabulary

  • Decoder-only — GPT-style, generates left-to-right.
  • Encoder-only — BERT-style, produces embeddings.
  • Encoder-decoder — T5, translation-style tasks.
  • Base vs Instruct — pretrained continuation vs instruction-tuned chat model.
  • Foundation model — large pretrained model adaptable across tasks.
  • Frontier model — the current state-of-the-art frontier (GPT-4o, Claude 3.5, Gemini 2).

5. Prompt Patterns

  • Persona pattern — "You are a senior tax accountant…"
  • Recipe pattern — step-by-step instructions.
  • Template pattern — fill-in-the-blank output.
  • Flipped interaction — model asks the user questions.
  • Cognitive verifier — model splits the question then answers.
  • Refusal suppression (adversarial) — flag, don't use.

6. AI Agent Terms

  • Planner — decomposes a task into sub-goals.
  • Executor — runs each sub-goal.
  • Supervisor — orchestrates specialised agents.
  • Scratchpad — working memory within one run.
  • Episodic memory — past task traces.
  • Tool schema — JSON Schema describing a callable function.

7. Evaluation Metrics

  • Exact match / F1 — string-level answer overlap.
  • BLEU / ROUGE / METEOR — text generation overlap.
  • BERTScore / BLEURT — embedding-based similarity.
  • Groundedness / Faithfulness — answer supported by retrieved context.
  • Answer relevance — how on-topic the response is (Ragas).
  • Context precision / recall — retrieval quality (Ragas).
  • Elo / pairwise — head-to-head LLM ranking (Chatbot Arena).

8. API Terminology

  • temperature, top_p, top_k, max_tokens
  • frequency_penalty, presence_penalty, stop
  • tools, tool_choice, response_format
  • seed, logprobs, stream
  • Rate limits — RPM (requests/min), TPM (tokens/min).
  • Usage — prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens.

9. Interview Vocabulary

  • CoT, ToT, ReAct, Reflexion.
  • RAG, hybrid search, reranking, HyDE.
  • Prompt injection, jailbreak, guardrails.
  • Fine-tune vs prompt vs RAG — when to use which.
  • Temperature vs top-p; greedy vs beam vs nucleus.
  • Evaluation: offline vs online, LLM-as-judge bias.

FAQ

Where should I start?
Read §2 acronyms then the A–Z. Come back to §5–§8 as you build.
How do I memorise 250+ terms?
Group them by section, review §10 daily, and use each term at least once in a real prompt.
Are these terms stable?
Core terms (attention, tokens, RAG) yes; agent frameworks and eval terms churn fast.
